_notice: AI CROSS-CHECK of human labels. NOT a human label and NOT used by the analysis. data/labels.json (human, final) was not modified.
method: All 130 pending items were labelled blind (labels.json not read until after the AI labels were recorded) from the old/new tool text and schema, using the three class rules supplied in the task (cosmetic / schema-additive / semantic-intent). Items were regenerated via the analysis package with an empty label map; nothing in data/ was written for that.
caveat: One AI rater, one pass, no adjudication. Agreement with the author's labels shows reproducibility of the call by a second rater, not correctness. The author's labels are the record; they were not changed.
